literal_meaning: বাষ্পে ভারী (দম বা বাষ্পে ভারী হওয়া)
figurative_meaning_bn: যা সিদ্ধ হতে বেশি সময় লাগে
figurative_meaning_en: Something that takes a long time to cook or complete
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বইটি লিখতে দমে ভারী লাগছে।
পুরানো চাল দমে ভারী, তাই ধৈর্য ধরো।
example_sentences_in_english: Writing this book feels like old rice in steam; it's taking forever.
Be patient; this task is heavy in steam and will take time.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali cooking practices where old or dry rice takes longer to soften when steamed or pressure-cooked, symbolizing any prolonged process.
note: Often used in contexts involving food preparation in rural or semi-urban Bengali households.
